newsitem.title: USA: M.A.HANNA says earnings, revenues to rise.
newsitem.headline: M.A.HANNA says earnings, revenues to rise.

text.p: M.A. Hanna Co said Thursday it is targeting annual revenue growth of 13 to 15 percent and wants to reach $4 billion in revenues by the year 2001.
The company believes earnings per share will grow at an even faster rate, President Douglas McGregor said.
The company will also pursue acquisitions in its core businesses to fuel its growth, McGregor said.
McGregor was recently named to succeed Martin Walker as chief executive, effective January 1.

The company said it also seeks to raise its return on invested capital from 16 percent to 18 to 20 percent; increase return on equity from 11 percent to at least 15 percent and raise its international sales to 25 percent of total sales, from the current level of 20 percent.
The Ohio-based specialty chemicals company with a core business in plastics and rubber processing and distribution.
